title: Human resources manager
description: JOB OVERVIEW:  The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.  ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:  Talent Development & Retention  Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.  Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.  Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.  Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.g., workshops, speakers, Ed Camps).  Attracting & Retaining Talent  Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.  Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.  Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.  Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.  Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.  Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.  Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.  Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture  Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.  Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.  Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.  Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.  Compliance and Child Protection  Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.  Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws  Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).  Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.  Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.  Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.  Wellbeing  Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.  Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.  Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.  Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.  Health (physical and mental/emotional) Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.  Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.  Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.  Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.  Other duties, as assigned.  POSITION REQUIREMENTS  BA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field 5+ years of experience  HR policies, procedures, and best practices  Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA) HR Information Systems (HRIS) Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle  Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking  Professional development and training frameworks  Child protection and safeguarding protocols  Cultural competence and sensitivity.  Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in Portuguese  Other Skills (Desirable):  Excellent communication (verbal and written) Strong organizational and time management abilities  High attention to detail  Problem-solving and conflict resolution  Interpersonal skills and empathy  Confidentiality and discretion  Data analysis  Adaptability and proactivity  Cultural awareness and sensitivity  Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Preschool teaching assistant (maternity cover)
description: JOB OVERVIEW:  The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.  Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.  ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:  Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.  Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.  Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.  Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.  CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:  Instructional Support and Student Learning  Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.  Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.  Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.  Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.  Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.  Student Care and Learning Environment  Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.  Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).  Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.  Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.  Operational and School Support  Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.  Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.  Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.  Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.  Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.  Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.  Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.  Professional Conduct and Growth  Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.  Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.  Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.  Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.  Additional Responsibilities  Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.  Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.  Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.  Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.  Working Conditions  Walk on paths and rough terrain  Lifting backpacks and school materials  Other duties, as assigned.  POSITION REQUIREMENTS:  Degree in Pedagogy, preferred  Five years experience working with children, preferred  PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred) English level required: B2 or above  Portuguese level required: B2 or above  Other Skills (Desirable):  Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect  Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment  Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills  Strong professional organization skills  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.  We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.  At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Coordenador de logística
description: Sobre a Vaga:  O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos. Essa função exige sólidos conhecimentos técnicos em logística para avaliar especificações, negociar com fornecedores e alinhar as atividades de compras às necessidades operacionais e estratégicas.  Ele/Ela se reportará ao Diretor de Compras Sub-Regional e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as fábricas e os especialistas locais em Compras de Transporte, a fim de garantir a continuidade do fornecimento e a competitividade das licitações dos fornecedores.  Principais Atribuições:  Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).  Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.  Negociar contratos e termos comerciais, visando otimizar o custo total e o prazo de entrega.  Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores (SLA, qualidade, pontualidade, custo), conduzir análises de negócios e estabelecer ações corretivas conforme necessário.  Colaborar com as equipes técnicas e operacionais para garantir que as compras atendam aos requisitos logísticos e de produção.  Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras que reduzam riscos e aumentem a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.  Manter atualizado o banco de dados de fornecedores e o mapeamento de mercado.  Apoiar o processo orçamentário e as premissas de tendências de mercado.  Gerenciar os custos logísticos, incluindo planejados versus reais, por cliente/região e como percentual da receita.  Acompanhar a legislação.  Implementar as melhores práticas; colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizado, impulsionando a melhoria contínua.  Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com operações/fábricas, fornecedores e consultores para otimizar gastos por meio de projetos técnicos.  Estabelecer uma rotina de Rastreamento e Acompanhamento: monitorar entregas, reclamações, ocorrências e custos extras, se houver.  CRM (Gestão de Relacionamento com o Cliente) responsável por Incidentes/Reclamações Logísticas.  Requisitos Obrigatórios:  Graduação em Logística, Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.  Mais de 10 anos de experiência em compras e gestão de suprimentos na área de logística.  Conhecimento técnico de processos logísticos, transporte e armazenagem.  Sólidas habilidades de negociação e gestão de contratos.  Experiência com compra/negociação de fretes.  Excelentes habilidades de apresentação e comunicação em espanhol e inglês.  Capacidade de influenciar e obter apoio em situações "de linha pontilhada".  Compreende as necessidades do negócio.  Disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Especialista em ia e business intelligence
description:
Você é movido por dados, inovação e inteligência artificial?Se você curte transformar informação em estratégia, desenhar soluções inteligentes e gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio, essa vaga pode ser para você!
Venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e contribua com a nossa missão de tornar a internet um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas.
ComoEspecialista em IA e Business Intelligence, sua missão será liderar iniciativas que ampliem a eficiência do canal de vendas em cibersegurança por meio de automações, modelos preditivos e dashboards estratégicos — fornecendo à liderança insights precisos e acionáveis que impulsionem receita, performance e crescimento.
O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.Responsabilidades:Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.Requisitos e Perfil:Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
Conhecimento em SQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/Look ML, publicação);
Inglês técnico;
Interesse por cybersecurity.Diferenciais:Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
Projetos com LLMs, Lang Chain, RAG ou chatbots;
Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou Saa S B2 B.
Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.Sobre a UPX:Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.
Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDo S, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.
Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end node.js
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.js- Sênior.Procuramos alguém com perfil colaborativo, boa comunicação e habilidade para se adaptar a diferentes desafios técnicos e organizacionais. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente!
Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando Type Script e Express.
Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (My SQL, Postgre SQL) e/ou No SQL (Mongo DB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.
Utilizar ORMs como Type ORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.
Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (Git Flow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (Rabbit MQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, Dev Ops, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.Resquisitos:
Experiência sólida com Node.js e Type Script, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
Uso de Express (ou Nest JS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (Rabbit MQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: My SQL ou Postgre SQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com Graph QL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
Git Profundo: workflows Git Flow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.Habilidades:Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, Code Igniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
Frameworks Node.js avançados: Nest JS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C): conhecimento em Terraform ou Cloud Formation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, Open Telemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, Rabbit MQ, AWS SNS/SQS, Web Sockets (Socket.io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.js/Type Script, integração com Dynamo DB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway).Benefícios:
Vale Alimentação/Refeição via cartão Ifood Benefícios.
Ajuda de custo ou vale transporte via Ifood Benefícios.

Assistência odontológica (extensiva à dependentes)
Day off e mimo no aniversário.
Seguro de vida.
Licença maternidade estendida.
Espaço interativo com videogame.
Espaço de descompressão #DESLIGUER.
Frutas todos os dias
Estacionamento.
Treinamentos constantes e oportunidades de desenvolvimento.Condições de Trabalho:

title: Human resources manager
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:Talent Development & Retention
Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.
Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.
Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.
Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.g., workshops, speakers, Ed Camps).Attracting & Retaining Talent
Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.
Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.
Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.
Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.
Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.
Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.
Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture
Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.
Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.
Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.
Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.Compliance and Child Protection
Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.
Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws
Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).
Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.
Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.
Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.Wellbeing
Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.
Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.
Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.
Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.Health (physical and mental/emotional)
Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.
Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.
Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.
Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.Other duties, as assigned.POSITION REQUIREMENTSBA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field
5+ years of experience
HR policies, procedures, and best practices
Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA)
HR Information Systems (HRIS)
Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle
Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking
Professional development and training frameworks
Child protection and safeguarding protocols
Cultural competence and sensitivity.
Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in PortugueseOther Skills (Desirable):
Excellent communication (verbal and written)
Strong organizational and time management abilities
High attention to detail
Problem-solving and conflict resolution
Interpersonal skills and empathy
Confidentiality and discretion
Data analysis
Adaptability and proactivity
Cultural awareness and sensitivity
Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.Child Safeguarding
Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion
EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Preschool teaching assistant (maternity cover)
description:

Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.Operational and School Support

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.
Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.
Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.
Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.
Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.
Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.Professional Conduct and Growth

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.Additional Responsibilities
Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.
Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.Working Conditions

Portuguese level required: B2 or aboveOther Skills (Desirable):
Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment

title: Senior backend engineering analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.
Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.
Activities
While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:
Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities. Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies. Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., Whats App and SMS channels). Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs. Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
Master integrations and communications using REST APIs . Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!
Requirements Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir. Experience developing RESTful and g RPC APIs . Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns . Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies . Solid understanding of relational databases . Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.
We are looking for people who: Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes. Adapt quickly to change. Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels. In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.
Nice to have: Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure . Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin . Experience with distributed systems and microservices . Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ). Experience with messaging systems (e.g., Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Phoenix Pub Sub ). Knowledge of No SQL databases (e.g., Postgres, My SQL, Redis, Mongo DB, Elastic Search, etc.).
Benefits Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde. Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance. Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old. Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options. Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities. Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.
Our Hiring Process
In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Analista de operações pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.

Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.

Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team. 3. Quality Management & Control
Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions. 4. Safety Production & 5 S Management
Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
Promote and maintain 5 S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment. 5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement
Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.

Promote and maintain 5 S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.

Qualidade para Vida - Esta é a visão de negócio da GMReis, que há mais de 25 anos desenvolve, produz e comercializa sua linha de produtos, classificada em próteses ortopédicas.
A inovação tecnológica aliada à qualidade dos produtos são os valores buscados diariamente na GMReis para que a expectativa dos clientes, médicos e pacientes, seja plenamente atendida com segurança e eficácia.
A GMReis está sediada em Campinas/SP em uma área de 6.000 m², dentro de um moderno parque tecnológico, com equipamentos de produção e análise metrológica de última geração, e uma área limpa ISO classe 8 de 800 m² onde são fabricados enxertos ósseos e implantes biorreabsorvíveis.
Analista de Métodos e Processos
Horário: Segunda a quinta das 07:30h as 17:30h e na sexta das 07:30h as 16:30h
Local: Campinas/SP – 100% Presencial
Responsabilidades
• Auxiliar na definição técnica e desenvolvimento de novos produtos.
• Desenvolver fluxos, métodos e processos considerando equipamentos, layout, dispositivos e documentação.
• Estimar tempos de fabricação, ferramentas e dispositivos necessários para produção.
• Apoiar na definição, condução e validação de produtos e processos.
• Analisar, apoiar e solucionar problemas operacionais nas linhas de produção.
• Implantar modificações em produtos e processos em projetos de melhoria.
• Elaborar instruções de operação, setup e qualidade.
• Atuar em melhorias contínuas, buscando aumento de produtividade e redução de variabilidade.
• Seguir rigorosamente os padrões do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (SGQ) e atuar com foco na satisfação do cliente.
Requisitos obrigatórios Conhecimento sólido em desenho técnico industrial . Experiência comprovada em processos industriais . Conhecimento intermediário em GD& T (tolerâncias geométricas). Experiência básica em software de desenho 3 D . Ensino superior em engenharia mecânica ou áreas correlatas
Imprescindível Residir em Campinas ou Hortolândia, Monte Mor, Sumaré, Paulínia ou Valinhos.
Diferenciais
• Conhecimentos em IA aplicada à manufatura .
• Vivência em usinagem de precisão ou dispositivos médicos.
• Experiência com RMOP, Auto CAD ou sistemas de documentação técnica.
• Conhecimento em metrologia e controle dimensional.
Soft skills desejadas
• Resiliência
• Boa comunicação
• Bom relacionamento interpessoal
• Organização e pensamento analítico
Benefícios :
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Auxílio combustível;
Convênio médico coparticipativo para o colaborador;
Convênio odontológico para colaborador e dependentes;
Seguro de vida.

title: Senior software test designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?
“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."
Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer
What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?
As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.
Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:
Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.
What do we offer you?
This will make you smarter:
challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
tech events and knowledge sessions.
This will make you better:
contract for indefinite period of time;
an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance; good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.
This will keep you healthy:
a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.
What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.
Our organization
Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.
Diversity & Inclusion
At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Engenheiro de software embarcado
description:
Must Have Technical/Functional Skills
· hands-on experience in Automotive ECU development and embedded software
engineering, covering complete V-model lifecycle.
· Deep technical expertise in CAN, UDS, Diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols
with proven track record in software integration and testing.
· Expertise in Embedded C/C++, CAPL, RTOS, Device Drivers, MCAL
· Understanding of Continuous Integration/Continuous (CI/CD) using Jenkins, and version control
systems like Git and SVN.
· Strong understanding of ASPICE, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), and Agile/Scrum development
methodologies.
· Understanding of AUTOSAR methodology
· Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities with a holistic understanding of
hardware-software co-development.
· Experienced in conducting design/code reviews, and driving technical excellence across cross-
functional teams.
Roles & Responsibilities
1. Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units). · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments). · Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar. 2. System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints. 3. Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits). 4. Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries. 6. Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:
Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;

Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.What do we offer you?
This will make you smarter:
challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
tech events and knowledge sessions.This will make you better:
contract for indefinite period of time;
an all-in employee benefit package( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.This will keep you healthy:
a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.Our organization
Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

title: Analista de cobrança e retenção

Seu papel é estratégico: garantir que o cliente mantenha clareza sobre seu plano de crescimento, entenda os próximos passos e execute corretamente a jornada para renovar e recomprar com previsibilidade.
Nesta função, você atuará com abordagem consultiva, combinando princípios de Customer Success, operações de cobrança, recuperação de crédito e gestão de objeções, sempre com foco na manutenção da receita e saúde da carteira.

Estruturar negociações e acordos financeiros que permitam continuidade saudável do contrato.

Acompanhar SLAs de contatos, follow-ups, acordos e compromissos assumidos.
Mapear riscos de cancelamento e agir preventivamente para evitar churn.
Alimentar o CRM com histórico, status, acordos e próximos passos, mantendo previsibilidade e organização.
Colaborar com times internos (CS, financeiro, comercial e operações) na construção de rotinas que melhorem retenção e adimplência.
Gerar percepções qualitativas sobre comportamento dos clientes, objeções recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no produto/atendimento.

Comunicação clara e empática: saber conduzir conversas difíceis sem perder a conexão.

Resiliência emocional: lidar bem com cenários críticos, objeções, frustrações e pressão.

Organização e precisão: registrar dados e cumprir processos com excelência.
Visão sistêmica: enxergar a jornada completa do cliente e o impacto da retenção na empresa.

- Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units) . · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments ).

- Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries.
- Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

title: Engenheiro de qualificação de software embarcado
description:
Engenheiro de Qualificação de Software Embarcado
Formação requerida:
Engenharia de Computação, Elétrica ou Eletrônica, Ciência da Computação ou cursos relacionados.
Descrição da posição:
Será responsável por desenvolver, manter, executar e analisar sistemas de verificação automatizados para sistemas embarcados, garantindo a qualidade e confiabilidade dos nossos produtos.
Responsabilidades:
- Especificar e detalhar testes de verificação de sistemas, incluindo abordagens de caixa-preta e caixa-cinza.
- Analisar a cobertura de testes e garantir a eficácia dos testes realizados.
- Implementar testes manuais e automatizados, empregando códigos na linguagem C#, em ambientes integrados para desenvolvimento, teste e análise de Unidades de Controle Eletrônico (ECUs) individuais e redes completas de ECUs no setor automotivo. Isso inclui a utilização da estação Vector VT System, com o suporte da ferramenta de software Vector CANoe.
- Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de desenvolvimento de software para entender e depurar funcionalidades, garantindo a implementação de ferramentas comuns.
- Configurar, executar e analisar testes utilizando ferramentas automáticas, como Jenkins.
- Gerar relatórios de testes e alimentar as ferramentas de controle de projeto, como Jira, para correções, melhorias e para o desenvolvimento do ambiente de teste.
- Configurar e desenvolver trabalhos automatizados para otimizar os processos de teste.
- Realizar a manutenção dos ambientes e equipamentos de teste para garantir sua eficiência e confiabilidade.
Requisitos:
- Experiência comprovada em ambientes de testes de verificação, preferencialmente em empresas do setor automotivo.
- Fluência em inglês, com habilidade para participar de reuniões diárias no idioma.

title: Estágio em comunicação interna
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST! Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.
Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!
São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e e Commerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!
Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!
Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:
Buscamos uma pessoa Estagiária de Comunicação Interna para se unir ao nosso Time de People & Culture para:
Dar apoio na gestão dos canais de comunicação interna, atuando na produção de conteúdo, engajamento e impulsionamento das ações e projetos da área de People & Culture;
Colaborar no planejamento, desenvolvimento e execução de campanhas, eventos e projetos de comunicação interna, utilizando estratégias de employer branding e endomarketing;
Realizar criação e produção de materiais de comunicação interna: apresentações, posts e materiais;
Auxiliar na edição de vídeos e materiais de treinamento, bem como de ações internas em geral;
Contribuir no suporte da gestão das mídias sociais da HST.
Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:
Cursando superior em Publicidade e Propaganda, Comunicação Social, Jornalismo ou correlatos;
Conhecimento em Creative Cloud (Photoshop/Illustrator/In Design);
Experiência com Power Point;
Disponibilidade de estagiar por ao menos um ano conosco;
Disponibilidade para estagiar 30h mensais no período vespertino;
Disponibilidade de atuar presencialmente 1 vez por semana na sede em Campinas/SP;
Residir na Região Metropolitana de Campinas.
Será um grande diferencial se: Inglês/Espanhol Avançado.
O que oferecemos?
A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !
Modelo Híbrido;
Horário flexível;
Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
Auxílio Home Office;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
Well Hub (antiga Gympass);
Convênio médico;
Convênio odontológico;
Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
Seguro de Vida.
Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Executivo de contas
description:
Executivo de Contas – Ricoh
Buscamos um Executivo de Contas com perfil Hunter, com forte foco em prospecção e desenvolvimento de novos negócios. É necessário possuir carro próprio e desejável inglês intermediario. O profissional ideal terá domínio de sistemas de vendas, CRM e gestão de pipeline, além de forte capacidade de relacionamento e visão estratégica.
O profissional deve ter experiência em outsourcing de impressão e soluções relacionadas ao portfólio da Ricoh, especialmente em soluções de Impressão, Notebooks e Desktops. O conhecimento em Soluções Áudio e Vídeo para Salas de Reunião será um diferencial.
O cargo exige presença no escritório em Barueri de 1 a 2 vezes por semana e disponibilidade para visitas em cliente na cidade de São Paulo e Grande São Paulo.
Principais responsabilidades:
Gerenciar carteira de clientes corporativos, com foco em soluções de outsourcing de impressão e Daa S
Atuar de forma consultiva, identificando necessidades e propondo soluções personalizadas
Elaborar propostas comerciais, negociar contratos e acompanhar todo o ciclo de vendas
Utilizar ferramentas de CRM para gestão de oportunidades e pipeline
Trabalhar em parceria com áreas técnicas e operacionais para garantir a excelência na entrega dos serviços
Benefícios:
Salário base competitivo
Esquema atrativo de bônus e comissões
Assisténcia Médica e Odontológica

Previdência privada
Canal de atendimiento ao colaborador
Aniversariante do Mês
Licenças especiales

title: Analista de contratos
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade
Estamos em busca de um Analista de Contratos detalhista, responsável e com perfil analítico, para atuar como guardião dos processos de novos contratos de clientes da empresa.
Este profissional será o ponto central na auditoria, monitoria, controle, qualidade, registro e acompanhamento de contratos comerciais e operacionais , garantindo que todos os documentos sejam formalizados corretamente, lançados nos sistemas internos e acompanhados em seus respectivos fluxos financeiros e jurídicos.
Responsabilidades Auditar e revisar todos os novos contratos firmados, garantindo aderência às políticas e padrões da empresa, a auditoria não se limita somente a analise documental, mas tambem em avaliar as ligações, videos, grações e conversas de whatsapp; Controlar e registrar contratos nos sistemas financeiros e planilhas de gestão, mantendo versionamento e histórico atualizado; Apontar pendências e inconformidades em tempo hábil, sinalizando responsáveis e acompanhando as correções; Gerar relatórios e indicadores das auditorias contratuais, apresentando análises e tendências de conformidade; Gerenciar o fluxo de recebíveis derivados dos contratos , acompanhando prazos de faturamento, pagamentos e renovações; Criar e manter gatilhos automáticos e reports recorrentes , com alertas sobre vencimentos, reajustes e obrigações financeiras; Atuar junto aos times Comercial, Financeiro e Jurídico para garantir a formalização adequada de todos os contratos; Zelar pela integridade, organização e segurança das informações contratuais , sendo o guardião do processo de formalização ; Participar da melhoria contínua dos processos de gestão contratual , propondo ajustes e automatizações que aumentem eficiência e rastreabilidade. Avaliar preço, produto, promoção, descontos das vendas , registrando contratos fora do padrão estabelecido;
Resgatar informações históricas de contrato para analise de cobrança, retenção, cancelamento;
Requisitos Formação superior completa em Administração, Direito, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial ; Experiência prévia com gestão, auditoria ou controle de contratos (comercial, jurídico ou administrativo); Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão (ERP, CRM, financeiro) e boas práticas de versionamento e compliance documental; Habilidade com planilhas e ferramentas de automação de relatórios (Google Sheets, Excel, Power BI, entre outros); Organização, atenção a detalhes e postura crítica frente a erros e inconsistências;
Boa comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de integração com diferentes áreas da empresa.
Diferenciais Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, Saa S ou prestação de serviços recorrentes ; Vivência com gestão de contratos digitais ; Conhecimento básico em fluxos financeiros e gestão de recebíveis ; Perfil de auditor interno , com disciplina, senso de dono e visão de risco.
Perfil Ideal Buscamos alguém metódico, proativo e criterioso , que enxerga nos detalhes o caminho para a eficiência. Um profissional com mentalidade de compliance , capaz de transformar o controle de contratos em um processo sólido, rastreável e inteligente — garantindo segurança jurídica, previsibilidade financeira e suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica.
Benefícios e Remuneração:
Remuneração CLT + Bonus de performance da empresa.
Oportunidade de crescimento e desenvolvimento dentro da empresa.
Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador.

Identificar, atrair e capacitar novos assessores.
Desenvolver estratégias de expansão regional e comercial.
Prospectar e fechar parcerias B2 B com escritórios, MFO e WM.
Garantir performance e crescimento sustentável da base sob sua gestão.
Dar suporte no dia-a-dia da operação sob sua gestão.

Formação em Engenharias, Finanças, Administração ou Economia
Espírito empreendedor e visão de dono.
Experiência em expansão comercial e franshising.
Habilidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

Forte relacionamento com players do mercado financeiro ou de investimentos.
Foco em resultados, performance e relacionamento.
O que oferecemos:
Desenvolvimento estruturado com capacitação para crescimento dentro da companhia e possibilidade de partnership em função de atingimento de metas.
Modelo de parceria com alto potencial de ganhos.
Estrutura de suporte Bravaforte (marketing, treinamento e tecnologia)
CRM estruturado em plataforma própria.

title: Embedded software engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!
Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking for "Embedded Software Engineer "who wants to learn and transform his careerResponsibility:-Embedded Software Design & Development· Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotiveECUs (Electronic Control Units). · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers inC/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments).
- Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such asCANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar.
-System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints.
-Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies withISO 26262(Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits).
-Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure.
- Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries.
- Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.What can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: Plant manager
description:
Senior Plant Manager — Autoparts Industry | Betim, Brazil
A global autoparts player is seeking a Plant Manager to lead its largest and most complex operations in South America, based in Betim, Minas Gerais.This is a senior leadership role with full responsibility for plant operations, P&L, and organizational culture. The company is entering a new phase, after stabilizing its operations, it now seeks a leader capable of driving a cultural transformation in order to elevate the manufacturing culture to world-class standards of excellence and efficiency.The role calls for a strategic and hands-on leader, who acts as a developer of people, fostering learning, discipline, and excellence at all levels of the plant, someone able to combine technical depth with a people-centered approach, fostering continuous improvement, discipline, and high performance across the organization.It’s an opportunity for a leader who aims to leave a legacy through people.Key Responsibilities
Lead and develop a large-scale industrial operation with full accountability for performance, quality, and cost competitiveness;
Drive a cultural and operational transformation focused on discipline, efficiency, and continuous improvement;
Ensure alignment with global manufacturing excellence frameworks and customer expectations;
Inspire, develop, and engage teams toward sustainable high performance.Requirements
Solid experience as Plant Manager or equivalent senior manufacturing leadership role in autoparts industrial environments - mandatory;
Proven track record in leading large operations and managing transformation processes;
Strong leadership presence, with the ability to combine strategic perspective and hands-on execution;
High-level academic background in Engineering from a reputable or top-tier institution;
Willingness to relocate to the Betim/Belo Horizonte region once this is a 100% on-site position.
Advanced/Fluent English.Location:Betim, Minas Gerais, Brazil (on-site).Confidential Search— all applications will be treated with strict discretion.

‘- Manusear cargas, seja na empresa ou no cliente, respeitando a simbologia das embalagens e preservando a integridade das mercadorias;

O hospital atualmente conta com11salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico,110leitosde internação,14leitosdeUTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h.Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditaçãoONA 3e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

  • Proven ability to work effectively across diverse teams and project levels.
